title: VideoHallucer: Evaluating Intrinsic and Extrinsic Hallucinations in Large Video-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Yes Percentage Difference (Pct. Diff) and False Positive Ratio (FP Ratio) to measure the tendency of Large Video-Language Models (LVLMs) to disproportionately generate 'Yes' responses in binary VideoQA tasks.
